# Warp v0.1.1

Maintenance release for Warp.

## Fixes

- `Scrollable` no longer reuses a fallback content-height estimate across updates. Unknown-height content is probed again so changes in dynamic content do not leave stale scroll limits.

## Testing

- Expanded integration and end-to-end coverage for panel lifecycle, content wrappers, layouts, focus and input, tabs, floating panes, overlays, and the HTTP inspector.

## Documentation

- Refreshed the English and Russian API references and guides to match current behavior.
